_comment: Deterministic payee rules, evaluated in order. First match wins. 'treatment' decides where a row lands: pl = profit & loss, equity/asset/liability = balance sheet only, transfer = excluded entirely, exception = never auto-decided, always routed to a human.

SALE PROCEEDS, NOT REVENUE. Mercury tagged this Revenue and that is wrong. Goes on Form 4797 net of basis and selling costs. Needs the closing statement.

Monthly payments to a partner. If Cobblestone is a LENDER not a partner these are interest expense instead - confirm which.

Partner draw.

NOT a 1099 per Autumn, and NOT an owner draw either - Ron is not a member of Evergreen Creative, so a distribution to him cannot reduce owner equity. Three different things here: $6,800 from EC memo'd 'Savings for house' (personal), $50 from EC, and $6,460.04 from EFV memo'd '400 Waterside' (property work). If these repay money Ron put in, that is a LOAN FROM A RELATED PARTY - a balance-sheet liability, not an expense and not equity. No inbound money from Ron appears anywhere in 2025, so the loan must predate the year or be undocumented.
